settings.title: Cell renewal slows
settings.text: At 25, skin renews itself every 28 days. By 40, that cycle has stretched to 45–60 days. The same biology is there. It just needs fewer interruptions and more support to keep pace.

settings.title: Collagen production drops
settings.text: After 25, collagen production falls by roughly 1% per year. The structural protein that keeps skin firm isn't disappearing. Your body is producing less of it. That's a signal problem, not a structural one.

settings.title: The barrier weakens
settings.text: Your skin barrier is a lipid matrix: ceramides, fatty acids, cholesterol in specific ratios. When that matrix is disrupted by over-actives, the skin loses water faster than it produces it. Most actives make this worse.

settings.title: Chronic inflammation builds
settings.text: Low-grade, invisible inflammation is the root of almost every visible skin concern: spots, uneven tone, sensitivity, premature ageing. The industry addresses the symptoms. Longevity science addresses the source.

settings.heading_line_1: The industry has been treating the symptom,
settings.paragraph_1: A spot treatment clears the breakout before the barrier rebuilds. A hydration serum deposits moisture without activating the skin's own production. A brightening product suppresses melanin without addressing why it's being overproduced. Each product solves for the visible sign. None of them address the underlying biology that produced it.
settings.paragraph_2: The result is a maintenance loop. The products work while you use them. The moment you stop, the original condition returns. Not because your skin is broken. Because nothing was ever rebuilt.
settings.closing_paragraph: The real problem was never the spot or the dryness. It was the skin's own ability to repair itself, and nobody was rebuilding that.

settings.label: ANTI-AGEING
settings.text: Reacts to visible signs. Temporary result.

settings.label: REGENERATIVE
settings.text: Restores biological function. Result compounds. Skin maintains independently.

settings.heading: We use regenerative science in beauty.
settings.text: Most beauty reacts to what you can see. We work a layer beneath, restoring the conditions under which skin repairs itself.

settings.subtext: Most skincare treats one concern at a time. This works on the biology underneath all of them, at the same time.
settings.formula_subtext: Five biological processes, supported at once. This is what holds the result after the bottle is empty.

settings.title: Vitality
settings.paragraph_1: Cell renewal. The foundation of everything else. Without consistent renewal, nothing that's applied to the surface reaches the cells that need it.
settings.paragraph_2: Sun-safe bio-retinoids accelerate the renewal cycle without stripping the barrier. Active day and night, no sun restriction.
settings.footnote: * In Vitro Study Conducted to Test Effect of Bio-Retinoids on Human Dermal Fibroblasts.

settings.title: Recovery
settings.paragraph_1: Skin is always healing something. A breakout, a barrier stripped by actives, the small daily damage you never notice. Recovery is how fast skin closes those gaps and repairs itself before they show.
settings.paragraph_2: The serum speeds up how quickly cells move in to close a wound. Faster migration means less time spent visibly healing, and damage that resolves before it leaves a mark.
settings.footnote: * Wound Healing in Normal Human Dermal Fibroblast using Scratch Assay for SKIN LONGEVITY SYSTEM 5.

settings.title: Structure
settings.paragraph_1: Collagen. The protein that makes skin bounce back. Production declines from 25 onwards. A peptide complex signals the biology to support what's slowing.
settings.paragraph_2: Each peptide targets a specific biological function: synthesis, repair, inflammation control, moisture signalling. Simultaneously. Because the signals are interconnected.
settings.footnote: * Increase in Collagen 1 Levels in NHDF Cells Treated with SKIN LONGEVITY SYSTEM 3.

settings.title: Hydration
settings.paragraph_1: Not topical hydration. Biological hydration. The difference between skin that holds moisture because it's producing its own hyaluronic acid, and skin that's borrowing moisture from the air.
settings.paragraph_2: High and low molecular weight HA working together. High MW seals the surface. Low MW penetrates deep to signal production. The serum teaches the skin to do what the serum is doing.
settings.footnote: * Hyaluronan Synthase - 2 Promotion in NHDF Cells After 48-Hour Exposure to SKIN LONGEVITY SYSTEM S.

settings.title: Texture
settings.paragraph_1: Surface texture is the last signal skin sends — and the first thing people read. Roughness, uneven tone, and fine lines trace deeper dysfunction.
settings.paragraph_2: Controlled exfoliation paired with renewal actives refines the stratum corneum without the irritation that triggers rebound damage.
settings.footnote: * Profilometry assessment of skin roughness index during controlled use study.

settings.title: Calibration
settings.text: Your skin is adjusting, and you start to feel a surface-level softness. The least any serum should do is make skin soft. We treat this as the starting line, not the finish.

settings.title: First signals
settings.text: Texture begins to change. Hydration holds longer and skin starts to look plumper, the foundation of glass skin. The people around you may notice before you do.

settings.title: The shift
settings.text: Pigmentation lifts. Breakout frequency reduces. Barrier resilience improves. The change is happening below the surface, in the structure itself.

settings.title: Longevity
settings.text: This is not the end. It's the baseline. Skin that functions as designed, maintaining from a structurally different starting point. The goal of regenerative science: a result that holds.

settings.heading: 75 days is the commitment we ask for.
settings.subtext: It is the time the biology needs for the change to become structural instead of temporary. Not a round marketing number, the point at which results start to hold on their own. Here is what happens along the way.

settings.body: Three renewal cycles. Each builds on the last. By day 75 the change is structural, and it holds.
